title: Low-voltage syngas synthesis via BPM electrolysis of CO2 capture and aldehyde solution
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07845H, Paper
Po-Wei Huang, Hyeonuk Choi, Anush Venkataraman, Olivia Vulpin, Claudio A. Ruiz Torres, Danae A. Chipoco Haro, Yaguang Zhu, Erika R. Yamazaki, Kelsey B. Hatzell, Shannon W. Boettcher, Sankar Nair, Jihun Oh, Hakhyeon Song, Marta C. Hatzell
A bipolar membrane electrolyzer coupling bicarbonate electrolysis with formaldehyde oxidation directly produces syngas (H2 : CO = 1) at 1.7 V and 200 mA cm−2 with 200% combined Faradaic efficiency.
